column1: WHY BRYAN HAS NO ROCK
Because EMB and DTF is a Scorecard line this quarter, not a project. There is nothing to BUILD there — there is output to produce and report.
Giving Bryan a Rock so that everyone has one is fairness deciding structure. Membership and ownership are decided by function, never by fairness.
He owns a number, he reports it in the L10, and that is a full seat at the table.
OPEN QUESTION — HOW MANY ROCKS
Q3 was 6 for 6 with Luke carrying five. On that record the business has earned MORE Rocks, not fewer.
The argument for four with Luke owning one is not capacity. It is that every Rock Luke owns is a seat he has not handed off,
and the entire system exists to get him out of three of four seats.
Both readings are defensible. Decide it out loud, in the room, and write the reason here.

A Rock is never edited mid-quarter to make it easier. It is either kept, or killed out loud with a reason in this table.
